end.parentNote: Atharv practised noticing beak and foot features and explaining how they help birds eat or move. They used the method of matching a feature to its function, and correctly connected a long pointed beak with catching fish and webbed feet with swimming. They mixed up the label for the first feature and did not correct it later. At home, look at two bird pictures together and have Atharv name one beak or foot feature and explain its use.
